headline: HOMEBODY's rooms grow personalities — studies read, playrooms giggle
lede: The purpose tail climbs one more floor: rooms now read their own furniture, earn tallies, and pay the household back — with a name at the door and the earnings on the pause sheet.

notes.text: A Bookshelf standing in a built wing makes it a STUDY: every third read that finishes in the room pays an insight — the reader surfaces lighter and the house takes a quiet pride. A TV or radio makes it a PLAYROOM, and Pip now crosses the whole lot for the in-room toy while a nearer house radio waits; every third play pays a delight — giggles, a deeper kid bond, one pride.

Rooms are named by what stands on their floorboards (bedroom > study > playroom): a study wears an open book at its door, a playroom a giggle star; paid insights and giggles ride the pause sheet. Sell the toy mid-errand and the kid is paid but the room isn't — honest walk cost.

36 new peoplecheck gates and both mutants die named: loosening the study's in-room question lights exactly the house-shelf gate red; zeroing the playroom pull lights the gravitate + delight five red; restore, 1078/0. The no-tap attract pin re-passed untouched — the frozen demo run buys nothing, so old play is byte-identical.

The lane took its target from the never-dry rung: PICK RUSH was held by slot b (#2734) and FLOOR BOSS by QA (#2732), so HOMEBODY's lone unowned README gap — rooms with a personality — became the stage.
